en.description:
A complete game of chess, made for Watch.

Chess+ puts a beautiful, touch-friendly wooden chessboard right on your wrist. Play against an offline computer opponent across 10 difficulty levels, or share the watch for two-player pass-and-play. Dedicated to Kareem :)

DESIGNED FOR YOUR WRIST
• Large, clear pieces and a full board on one screen
• Simple tap-to-move controls
• Legal-move and last-move highlights
• Haptic feedback for every move
• Automatic board rotation in two-player games

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Computer opponent with difficulty levels 1–10
• Local two-player pass-and-play
• Works completely offline
• Includes castling, en passant, checkmate, stalemate, and pawn promotion

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account
• No ads or tracking
• No subscriptions or in-app purchases
• No personal data collection

From quick practice games to tougher challenges, Chess+ keeps a complete chessboard close at hand.

Your move.
en.subtitle: Offline strategy on your wrist
